title: trending-local-llms search/raw data contract
description: JSON Schema that each Firecrawl search snapshot in data/raw/<backend>-<UTC>.json must conform to. The four Hermes `make search-*` prompts (nvidia, metal, cpu, amd) write these. Each raw snapshot holds ONE backend's captured models; they aggregate into models.json (validated against model_contract.json). Enforced by scripts/validate.py (check_search_contract).

models.description: Models captured by this backend search. MUST carry the same core fields as the aggregated models.json contract so aggregation never produces a broken model.

vram_min.description: Least required VRAM (community-reported / from X or HF quant size).

system_ram_min.description: OPTIONAL. System RAM / unified-memory requirement the post states (e.g. '16GB'). Never derived from VRAM and never invented: copy only a figure the post gives.

weight_gb.description: OPTIONAL. Weight footprint per format + quant the post states (e.g. '5.95GB Q4_K_M'). Copy only a figure the post gives.

context_tokens.description: OPTIONAL. Context window the post states (e.g. '131072', '128K'). Copy only a figure the post gives.

storage_offload.description: OPTIONAL. Storage-offload requirement the post states (e.g. '640GB NVMe, experts on SSD'). Copy only a figure the post gives.

engine_min_version.description: OPTIONAL. Engine minimum version / required flags the post states (e.g. 'llama.cpp b6xxx, --n-gpu-layers 99'). Copy only a version or flag the post gives.

likes.description: Likes on the source X post backing this measurement (drives engagement-weighted t/s).

comments.description: Comments on the source X post backing this measurement.

reshares.description: Reshares/reposts of the source X post backing this measurement (strongest engagement signal).

views.description: Views of the source X post (reach; log-scaled in the engagement weight).

interactions.description: Total interactions on the source X post (likes+comments+reshares+views or the platform's reported total).

engine_repo.description: Optional. GitHub repo of the engine when it is NOT in the engines registry yet (from the post). Ingest auto-registers it only if the repo is classified as an inference engine; harnesses, agent frameworks, apps and benchmarks are never registered. Stripped before the store.

weight_gb.description: Optional. Weight footprint of the QUANT THIS MEASUREMENT RAN IN, as the post states it (e.g. '5.95GB PTQ1_0'). Per measurement, not per model (issue #337). A figure only the post gives; never derived.

context_tokens.description: Optional. Context window this measurement ran with, as the post states it (e.g. '131072').

system_ram_min.description: Optional. System RAM / unified memory this measurement needed, as the post states it (e.g. '16GB'). Never derived from a VRAM figure.

storage_offload.description: Optional. Storage-offload this measurement needed, as the post states it (e.g. '640GB NVMe, experts on SSD').

reshares.description: Total reshares/reposts across the model's source X posts (additive; optional).

interactions.description: Total interactions across the model's source X posts as reported by the platform (additive; optional).
